customize.text:
Wanjiru was a warrior of the Collective of Plenty who wielded Electro and one of the six heroes of Natlan who lived over five hundred years ago. She bore the Ancient Name
the same name as the founder of Teteocan, Ahpub. She had been friends with Mavuika since their youth, before the latter became a Pyro Archon, and they often had competitions. Mavuika always won, but on the last night before she became Archon, Wanjiru finally prevailed. As a mighty warrior, Wanjiru could split a hundred-year-old ironwood in half with a single wave of her hand. Raw ore crumbled to powder in her hands, and even the toughest metal was as malleable as misshapen mud in her fingers. She was tormented day and night by the thought of finding a weapon to match her strength, until one day, around the tribe’s campfire, she heard a story about a dragon's tomb where it kept its legacy. Wanjiru leaped from the summit of Tollan into the volcano and entered the abandoned ruins. She followed the traces left behind by the heroes who once fought a vicious battle against the great dragon, and dreamed of being born during the time of the first Archon, so that legends would be told of her too. In the jagged boneyard that the storyteller had so grimly described by the bonfire, there was nothing more than the lonely corpses of a few giant beasts who had met gruesome ends. Wanjiru reached out her hand in disappointment, but saw in a trance a shadow flying toward her, wings spread. She had no time to think, and so she engaged in battle with the golden shadow. It was a brutal battle, but she finally prevailed. With blood-stained hands, she tore off the shattered wing of the enormous dragon. When Wanjiru came to her senses, she found herself standing with her hand extended, as if the recent battle had been nothing more than a nightmare. Or was it a dream? The warrior felt pain in her battered arms, and in her palm lay a heavy dragon bone, just like the tail of the giant beast she had caught in battle.

When the Cataclysm began five hundred years ago, and the monsters of the Abyss appeared in Natlan, the great runner Wanjiru and her Tatankasaurus companion Kayeke were the first to join the exiled hero Tenoch, who had decided to unite the warring tribes. Though the constant infighting among the major tribes was exhausting, Tenoch's invitation had reignited her vigor. When Wanjiru told about her fight with the golden shadow to the heroes and warriors of Natlan, the High Priest of the Masters of the Night-Wind frowned and said that the Great Volcano of Tollan was forbidden ground, inaccessible to ordinary people. Her friend Sanhaj doubted it as well, for they had never seen Wanjiru draw that blade. But the warrior did not draw the sword, for there had been no need for it before, until a
washed over Natlan and the great
silhouette appeared on the horizon. And she gripped the hilt of that bleached bone blade, silently waiting for the battlefield where she would draw it once more.

During the war with the Abyss, the Natlanese calculations estimated that they would have a maximum of five hundred years before the Night Kingdom was completely lost to the Abyss, but at that time, Natlan lay in ruins, and the civilization was dying. It was necessary to unite the tribes, otherwise, it would be impossible to dream of a final victory. So, the Archon had a long and involved discussion with the heroes of each tribe, and finally came up with a five-hundred-year-long plan to save Natlan. During this time, the Archons and chiefs were to rebuild the tribes, and when the time came, the Wayob would again choose six heroes of Natlan with the Ancient Names of Xbalanque's companions. Wanjiru, who had been friends with Pyro Archon Mavuika since before her ascension and was constantly in competition with her, agreed to the plan and set out for the final battle alongside the other heroes of Natlan. None of the heroes returned from this battle, and the Pyro Archon placed her life into the Sacred Flame, to be reborn five hundred years later and carry out her plan. Five hundred years later, when Mavuika was reborn, Wanjiru's spirit helped her successor, Iansan, who inherited the Ancient Name Uwezo, share her power with the Archon to fight the Abyss.
